content: View-only market trackers (WoW Market Tracker/Auctionator PriceTracker/Market Watcher, Forza AH tracker, PoE OCR price check): record local snapshots of what player views, build per-item history (min/median/market value), watchlists targeting specific items instead of full scans, deal alerts vs reference price, sales log, staleness timestamps. OCR-based tools do opportunistic capture when market window open.
